engine.description: Runtime model and world coordinate system.

world_cell.description: One engine map-cell coordinate unit; 2.5 metres design scale.

item_display.description: Dimensionless local item coordinates; viewport auto-fit and no metre guarantee.

depth_tile.description: Unit XY surface domain for one 2.5m by 2.5m cell; Z is signed relief in cell units.

preview.description: Presentation-only coordinates with no gameplay or placement authority.

representations.plane: Two-dimensional field displaced along a surface normal.
representations.shell: Image-derived front/back or silhouette closed object.
representations.full_model: Explicit polygon geometry exchanged as OBJ/MTL.

roles.surface_material: Complete wall, floor, or ceiling surface.
roles.object_fixture: Persistent environment object; collision is separate.
roles.item_display: Inventory or item viewport model with no world-scale guarantee.
roles.structural_opening: Model associated with a passable or conditional opening; visual geometry does not define passability.
roles.preview_only: Inspection/documentation asset never promoted to production.

placementFrames.floor_center: world_cell origin at owning floor cell centre; +Z up.
placementFrames.wall_center: world_cell origin at visible wall-face centre; +X outward, +Y tangent, +Z up.
placementFrames.ceiling_center: world_cell ceiling-cell centre; hanging geometry normally extends negative local Z.
placementFrames.opening_center: world_cell opening centre at floor level; local Z vertical.
placementFrames.item_viewport: item_display root-origin frame fitted by viewport bounds.
placementFrames.surface_domain: depth_tile XY domain spanning one surface cell.
placementFrames.preview_frame: preview-only frame with no runtime placement authority.

variants.description: Parallel visual alternatives, distinct from semantic states; transient provider candidates may be numeric.

height_metric.purpose: Geometric truth and deterministic conversion input.

depth_guide.normalization: median subtract, p99 absolute-deviation normalize, clip
